Welcome to The Training Room PT – where movement meets performance! Our channel is dedicated to helping active individuals move better, get stronger, and stay pain-free. As a fellowship-trained physical therapist, I break down rehab, mobility, and strength strategies to keep you in the gym and performing at your best. Whether you're recovering from an injury or optimizing movement, you'll find expert tips on strength-based rehab, mobility drills, and breathing mechanics. Subscribe for actionable strategies to stay pain-free and improve performance! #PhysicalTherapy #StrengthRehab #Mobility
